stem.text: Two identical cars P and Q are travelling along a straight road. Car Q is travelling at twice the speed of car P. The brakes are applied to both cars, producing the same constant deceleration.
Which graph shows how the velocity $v$ of each car varies with time $t$?

A.alt: Graph with v on the vertical axis and t on the horizontal axis, both axes starting at 0, with two curves labelled P and Q.

B.alt: Graph with v on the vertical axis and t on the horizontal axis, both axes starting at 0, with two curves labelled P and Q.

C.alt: Graph with v on the vertical axis and t on the horizontal axis, both axes starting at 0, with two lines labelled P and Q.

D.alt: Graph with v on the vertical axis and t on the horizontal axis, both axes starting at 0, with two curves labelled P and Q.
